Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: Trainer saves the profile application as a draft without submitting it for review.

Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: Trainer completes all required fields and proof documents, then submits successfully for Admin review.

Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: Admin rejects a pending Trainer profile with a reason.
column3: 1. Open an AWAITING_APPROVAL profile's detail. 2. Tap Reject and enter a rejection reason (e.g. "Diploma image unreadable"). 3. Confirm.
column4: Status changes from AWAITING_APPROVAL to a rejected state; the reason is recorded and shown to the Trainer on their Application Tracking screen; the Trainer receives an in-app notification and a rejection email containing the reason.
